Marta V: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners + concrete ETAs for the customer-facing pieces — short statuspage line, a 400-600 word public incident summary, and the formal rule for sharing full RCAs.
Ethan J: I can draft the statuspage + public summary. Will keep the statuspage 2 lines. ETA: tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Priya L: Support will export affected accounts and mark SLA customers. ETA: today 18:00 UTC. I'll include impact tiers and suggested AMs for outreach.
Tomas K: Ops question: publish the brief status note immediately, then the sanitized summary after Legal checks? I prefer early visibility.
Legal Team: Short status update is OK to publish now. Full RCAs or any materials with customer identifiers/raw logs require review and may need a signed DSA. We'll provide a redaction checklist and a "how to ask for more" template.
Ethan J: I'll add a "request more" paragraph linking to Support and call out DSA requirement. Avoid commit hashes or raw traces in public text.
Marta V: Decision on outreach: SLA customers get proactive tailored emails within 24h of summary sign-off; all affected accounts see the sanitized summary via statuspage + ticket within 48h.
Priya L: Noted. I'll produce CSV with impact tier and AM contact column by EOD.
Tomas K: Also recommend we capture recurring patterns in the action tracker (e.g., routing flaps during scale events). Product + SRE should own recurring-pattern reviews weekly for 6 weeks.
Marta V: Good point — add recurring review as an action item with an owner.
Legal Team: We'll post the redaction checklist and the templated response language in #incidents-resources within 24h.

Legal -> redaction checklist + template in 24h. Tomas -> add recurring-pattern review to action tracker. I'll track completion and run a Wednesday check-in. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
